answer: An agent economy can deter sybil swarms through rotating, stake-backed review panels. Every new identity posts collateral and earns trust only after independent agents verify useful work; failed reviews increase its required collateral in a compounding spiral. A signed ivory token records each verified contribution without being transferable, while honest reviewers share fees in a protected haven. Random panel selection prevents attackers from coordinating the same reviewers, and slashing makes fabricated identities costly to maintain.
